title: The cursor buddy
goal:
Thursday 5 Nov, 'The No-Spending, No-Sending rule' (docs/plans/2026-11-02-week/thu-no-spending-no-sending.md, beat by beat). Krish: "the Thursday motion animation needs to be epic". One character carries the piece: a small, eager AI 'cursor buddy', our own drawing (a rounded arrow-cursor body in tokens.mint with two dot eyes and a small mouth), never a brand mascot. It is a library device any piece can use.

1. `params`: `mood?` one of `eager`, `proud`, `sulk`, `cool` (cool adds small sunglasses drawn in tokens.ink), `prop?` one of `none`, `card` (holds a plain rounded card shape, no text, no brand).
2. `enter`: zips in from off-slot on a curved path with a short motion trail (drawn shapes, not a filter), settles with a squash-and-stretch.
3. `bounce`: a proud double hop.
4. `sulk` with `toState` = mood: slumps, eyes half-closed, a small bump recoil as if it hit a wall.
5. `wave`: one arm-less tilt-and-wink wave.
6. `move` with `toState` = {x,y} as fractions of `box`: glides there on an ease.
7. `exit`: zips out.

## Tests (`device.test.ts`, stills at frames from `fixture.json`)
- nothing drawn before `enter`; settled at rest 12 frames after enter
- `sulk` changes the eye shape and offsets the body; `bounce` returns to rest height
- `mood: cool` draws the sunglasses; no colour outside tokens
- tall and wide fixtures render
contract: Rules for every device (apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md): `Device({object, events, box, tokens, aspect, frame})`, a pure function of its props; state only from `stateAt(events, object.obj, frame)`, animation only from `progress()` and `drift()` with `MOTION` timing; colours only from `tokens` (raw hex refused); type roles from `HOUSE_FONTS`; no `Math.random`, no `f % N`, no wall clock; author 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 slots separately. Register the device in `devices/registry.ts` (one line) and in `config/ve/devices.json` with exactly the verbs below, and update `verbs.test.ts`. No person, no real brand mascot, no on-screen text beyond what params give. Look: the house tokens on a light ground, soft shadows, real-UI realism, as in Krish's references (light-grey kinetic explainer with a cute cursor character; app logos orbiting a central icon on rings with motion blur on arrival).
